name: model-card
title: Monitoring definition and evidence
for_each: SELECT id,name,version FROM models ORDER BY name,version

sections.title: Recorded reviews
sections.sql: SELECT actor,created_at,result->>'status' AS status,result->>'distance' AS distance,result->>'mae' AS mean_absolute_error FROM evaluations WHERE model_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at

name: remediation-brief
title: Monitoring follow-up brief
for_each: SELECT id,name FROM models ORDER BY name

sections.title: Open work
sections.sql: SELECT title,owner,due FROM actions WHERE model_id=$1 AND status='open' ORDER BY due

sections.title: Evidence notes
sections.sql: SELECT body,actor,created_at FROM notes WHERE model_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at

sections.title: Compliance support
sections.sql: SELECT rule,due,source_rule FROM compliance_findings WHERE model_id=$1
